anna-partnerships: Need a minimal SI co-sell pipeline flow for marketplace + hardware bundles. Quick decisions: claim window, SFDC tags, and announcement gating.

 tom-sales: High level: partner-registered -> partner assigned; marketplace inbound -> auto-tag marketplace, partner gets 48h to claim; named accounts stay with AE.

 rachel-revops: Agree. Suggest SFDC required fields: partner_registered=true/false, partner_name, co_sell_type=marketplace|si|joint_announce, partner_credit_pct. Validation: credit_pct required if registered.

 emma-marketing: For joint_announce tag, marketing and legal must be notified automatically. Add announcement_type field and "contains_infra_details" checkbox to route to security.

 tom-sales: Claim SLA 48 business hours globally. If unclaimed -> AE triage. Partner must be CC'd on first outreach if they claimed.

 anna-partnerships: Draft email template for partner claim will be added to portal. Also hardware bundles require a joint delivery and PO lead-time field.

 devbot: Created card PRT-506 "SI pipeline tags + claim SLA" assigned to anna-partnerships, rachel-revops; due in 5 days.

 rachel-revops: I'll add fields and a report for pending partner claims.

 anna-partnerships: Action items: anna publish short playbook, rachel implement SFDC fields, tom update AE playbook, emma draft announcement intake. Pilot with one SI in 2 weeks.

 tom-sales: Happy to run pilot.

 anna-partnerships: Thanks team, will send v0.1 after changes. :thumbsup:
